testingFunctionality: Login with valid student credentials
expectedResult: User is redirected to /dashboard with student role

testingFunctionality: Login with invalid password
expectedResult: "Incorrect username or password." error is shown and the user stays on the credentials step

testingFunctionality: Login with non-existent username
expectedResult: "Incorrect username or password." error is shown and no session is created

testingFunctionality: Complete OTP verification with the correct code after valid credentials
expectedResult: Session is created and user is redirected to /dashboard

testingFunctionality: Logout from any role
expectedResult: Session is cleared and user is redirected to /login

testingFunctionality: Browse upcoming events on the Discover tab
expectedResult: Approved events with a proposed date today or later are listed, sorted soonest first

testingFunctionality: Browse past events on the Past tab
expectedResult: Approved events with a proposed date before today are listed, sorted most recent first

testingFunctionality: Register for an event with open capacity
expectedResult: Registration is created, a success toast is shown, and the event card CTA changes to "Registered"

testingFunctionality: Attempt to register for an event that is at capacity
expectedResult: Registration is rejected with "This event is full." and the CTA shows "Event Full"

testingFunctionality: View My Tickets for an upcoming, not-yet-checked-in registration
expectedResult: A QR code encoding the registration id is displayed on the ticket

testingFunctionality: View My Tickets for a registration that has already been checked in
expectedResult: A green checkmark and "You're checked in!" are shown instead of the QR code

testingFunctionality: Click "Join" on a club the student hasn't applied to
expectedResult: The club application modal opens

testingFunctionality: Submit the club application form with all required fields filled in
expectedResult: A pending membership request is created with the submitted application data, and a success toast is shown

testingFunctionality: Submit the club application form with a required field (e.g. GPA) missing or invalid
expectedResult: A validation error is shown and the application is not submitted

testingFunctionality: View My History page
expectedResult: Past registrations are listed, each marked "Attended" or "Missed" based on check-in records

testingFunctionality: Navigate to an Event Detail page (/event/:eventId)
expectedResult: Event info, capacity bar, registration status, and the Q&A section load correctly

testingFunctionality: Navigate to a Club Profile page (/club/:clubId)
expectedResult: Club info, member list, and the club's events load correctly

testingFunctionality: Post a question on an Event Detail page
expectedResult: The question is saved and appears at the top of the Questions & Comments list

testingFunctionality: Use global search to find an event by title
expectedResult: Matching events are listed under an "Events" section, and selecting one navigates to /event/:eventId

testingFunctionality: Use global search to find a club by name
expectedResult: Matching clubs are listed under a "Clubs" section, and selecting one navigates to /club/:clubId

testingFunctionality: Toggle dark/light mode from the top bar
expectedResult: The theme switches immediately and the choice persists across reloads

testingFunctionality: Propose a new event with required fields filled in
expectedResult: A new event is created with status "pending" and appears in the club admin's event list

testingFunctionality: View proposed events list including a rejected event
expectedResult: Each event shows its current status, and rejected events display the reviewer's feedback text

testingFunctionality: Approve a pending club membership request
expectedResult: Membership status changes to "approved", a success toast is shown, and the list refreshes

testingFunctionality: Reject a pending club membership request
expectedResult: Membership status changes to "rejected", a success toast is shown, and the list refreshes

testingFunctionality: Expand a pending membership request to view application details
expectedResult: GPA, credit hours, major, faculty, skills, availability, and the "why" answer are displayed

testingFunctionality: Remove an existing approved member
expectedResult: A confirmation dialog appears, and confirming deletes the membership record

testingFunctionality: Answer a student's question on an Event Detail page for the admin's own club event
expectedResult: The reply is saved and displayed as "Answered by <admin name>" under the question

testingFunctionality: Select an event, scan a valid unused ticket QR code
expectedResult: Check-in succeeds, a "Checked in: <name>" toast is shown, and the scan log shows "Checked In"

testingFunctionality: Scan a ticket QR code that has already been checked in
expectedResult: An "Already checked in" error toast is shown and the scan log shows "Already Scanned"

testingFunctionality: View pending event proposals
expectedResult: All events with status "pending" are listed for review

testingFunctionality: Approve a pending event proposal
expectedResult: An approval record is created, the event's status changes to "approved", and it moves to the Approved list

testingFunctionality: Reject a pending event proposal with feedback text
expectedResult: A rejection record with the feedback is created and the event's status changes to "rejected"

testingFunctionality: Create a new user account via the Manage Users form
expectedResult: The account is created with the default password and a toast displays the new username/password

testingFunctionality: View all clubs on the Manage Clubs page
expectedResult: Every club is listed with its name and current admin assignment status

testingFunctionality: Assign a club admin to an unassigned club when creating their account
expectedResult: The new account is created and the selected club's adminId is set to that account

testingFunctionality: Select an event from the check-in event dropdown
expectedResult: The dropdown lists approved upcoming events, and the scanner activates once one is selected

testingFunctionality: Scan a valid ticket QR code for the selected event
expectedResult: Check-in succeeds and a "Checked in: <name>" success toast is shown

testingFunctionality: Scan a QR code that doesn't match any registration
expectedResult: An "Invalid QR code" error toast is shown and the scan log shows "Invalid"

testingFunctionality: Scan a ticket QR code that has already been checked in
expectedResult: An "Already checked in" error toast is shown and the scan log shows "Already Scanned"

testingFunctionality: View the venues list on the dashboard
expectedResult: All venues are listed with name, location, and capacity

testingFunctionality: View upcoming venue reservations on the dashboard
expectedResult: Upcoming reservations are listed with event title, venue name, and formatted time range

testingFunctionality: Update bio text and save
expectedResult: The bio is saved to the profile and a "Bio saved." toast is shown

testingFunctionality: Add an interest tag and save interests
expectedResult: The new tag appears in the interests list and is persisted with a "Interests saved." toast

testingFunctionality: Change password with a valid, matching new password
expectedResult: The password is updated and a "Password updated." toast is shown

testingFunctionality: Dark mode renders correctly across all pages
expectedResult: All UI elements use correct dark theme tokens

testingFunctionality: Dashboard loads within 3 seconds on first visit
expectedResult: Page is interactive within 3 seconds

testingFunctionality: Application is usable on 390px mobile width
expectedResult: All pages render correctly without horizontal scroll

testingFunctionality: Unauthenticated user tries to access /dashboard
expectedResult: Redirected to /login

testingFunctionality: QR scan creates checkin document in Firestore
expectedResult: checkin document written with correct fields
